question: Where is restaurant found within 120 kilometers along the way to Meadow Museum, Benson, NC from Aquarium Outfitters Carolina, Wake Forest, NC?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects( p.geometry, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry::geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Aquarium Outfitters Carolina%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wake Forest%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry::geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Meadow Museum%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Benson%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 120000 -- 120 kilometers in meters ) );
